info.title: CapIA Local API
info.description: Esqueleto gerado do catálogo único de operações. Respostas não são descritas campo a campo; ver docs/api/.

get.summary: Local counters: requests, errors, rate limits, in-flight work, uptime.

post.summary: Create a token (the secret is shown once).
Rotate a token: new secret (shown once), old one revoked.
Create (and open) a project in the server's project store.
Open a project (the engine hosts one at a time).
Close the open project.

get.summary: Revision, sequences, clips, assets and run counts.

post.summary: Stream a file into staging (raw body; Content-Length required).
Stage a small file sent as base64 (8 MiB max).
Import a staged upload through the asset system (hash + probe + catalog).

get.summary: One sequence (full content; use timeline.query for large ones).
Clips of a sequence by time range, paginated, with a content digest.

post.summary: Phase 1 of the write gate: validate a transaction and get a plan token (nothing is written).
Phase 2 of the write gate: apply only the reviewed plan.
Start an AI Run from brief + raw footage + references.

get.summary: Run snapshot (stages, effects, provenance, pending decision).

post.summary: Pause a run.
Resume a paused run.
Cancel a run.
Answer the pending approval/decision of a run.

get.summary: Production plan, edit plans and validation of a run.
Usage and budget of a run.

post.summary: Create variants from a completed run.

get.summary: Project/client/user memory items (read-only: promotion is a UI action).

post.summary: Queue exports of sequences (server chooses the output location).

get.summary: Approved export encoders available on this machine (capability catalog).

post.summary: Cancel the batch of an export.
Register a webhook (the signing secret is shown once).

delete.summary: Delete a webhook and its delivery log.

post.summary: New signing secret (shown once).
Queue a synthetic `webhook.test` delivery.

get.summary: Delivery log (attempt, status, latency, next retry, terminal state).

post.summary: Re-deliver one delivery (dead letters included).

get.summary: Server events after a cursor (polling; SSE at /v1/events/stream).
